description: This file defines the EmployeeJoinedDateChangedEvent class, which represents an event triggered when an employee's joined date changes within the OrangeHRM system. The class encapsulates information about the employee and their previous joined date, and extends a base Event class.

classes.name: EmployeeJoinedDateChangedEvent
classes.description: Represents an event triggered when an employee's joined date changes. Contains references to the Employee entity and the previous joined date, and extends the base Event class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with the Employee object and the previous joined date.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee object associated with the event.

methods.name: getPreviousJoinedDate
methods.description: Returns the previous joined date before the change, if available.
